column1: # W46 stage C2: UI-TARS-1.5-7B multi-step transfer matrix (OmniGUI).
# PROTOCOL, fixed by the stage-B gate and not to be varied per arm:
#   UITARS_NATIVE_MULTISTEP=1  -- UI-TARS's own action space and Action: contract,
#     with teacher-forced history rendered in the same DSL. Without it the model
#     emits <thought> and never an action (98% of steps), scoring a flat zero.
#   UITARS_COORD_RESCALE=1     -- the gate measured every emitted point inside
#     [0,1000] and a 71.68% grounding accuracy under this setting; it is the
#     protocol the model actually honours.
#   GEOPACT_SESSION_KV_FORCE=0 -- re-prefill path, so every arm here is compared
#     under identical serving and only the selector differs.
# REPORTING. Whole-episode Step SR on this backbone is dominated by a termination
# deficit: UI-TARS answers 100% of reference TASK_COMPLETE steps with something
# other than a termination, because it has no episode-level stop behaviour. That
# is a backbone property no token policy can move, so the headline metric is
# computed on reference-coordinate-bearing steps by
# scripts/w46_uitars_multi_metrics.py (subset defined by the REFERENCE action, so
# no arm can resize its own denominator). Whole-episode numbers stay in the
# appendix.
# GRID. 6 selectors x 2 budgets. History keep h = RATIO; the current frame is
# pruned by GEOPACT_PUBBASE_CURRENT for pub_* arms and GEOPACT_RATIO_CURRENT for
# the nap_*/TRACE family, matching how Tables 1-2 pair the two stages.
# BENCHMARK|TASK|TRACK|EXP_ARM|RATIO|HIST_N|OUT|LIMIT|EXTRA_ENV
# Full-token upper bound: without it the table has no denominator for retained
# performance. Listed first so it starts on the first freed GPU.
